name: GPO and SYSVOL statistics
description: Workspace-wide SysvolStats_CL statistics, latest snapshot per Environment (domain). Selected systems choose the workspaces only; all domains in those workspaces may be included. Zero denominators and missing measurements remain unknown, not zero.
kql:
SysvolStats_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| extend Environment = tostring(Environment)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Environment
| extend TotalBytes = todouble(GPODiscSize), LargeBytes = todouble(LargeGPODiscSize), LargeCount = todouble(LargeGPOs), UnlinkedCount = todouble(UnlinkedGPOs)
| extend Metrics = bag_pack('RecentlychangedGPOs', todouble(RecentlychangedGPOs), 'LargeGPOs', LargeCount, 'UnlinkedGPOs', UnlinkedCount, 'LargeUnlinkedGPOs', todouble(LargeUnlinkedGPOs), 'OrphanedGPOFolders', todouble(OrphanedGPOFolders), 'GPODiscSizeGiB', TotalBytes / 1073741824.0, 'LargeGPODiscGiB', LargeBytes / 1073741824.0, 'LargePct', iff(TotalBytes > 0, 100.0 * LargeBytes / TotalBytes, real(null)), 'AvgLargeMiB', iff(LargeCount > 0, LargeBytes / LargeCount / 1048576.0, real(null)), 'LargeUnlinkedPctOfUnlinked', iff(UnlinkedCount > 0, 100.0 * todouble(LargeUnlinkedGPOs) / UnlinkedCount, real(null)))
| mv-expand Dimension = bag_keys(Metrics) to typeof(string)
| project Timestamp = TimeGenerated, Series = iff(isempty(Environment), 'Unknown environment', Environment), Dimension, Value = todouble(Metrics[Dimension])
| order by Series asc, Dimension asc
